workflow.action: Produce deterministic candidate decisions, exact evidence and empty review templates from frozen development inputs.
Review no more than 24 development documents in one pass and decide only relations that can be stated as general rules.
Write accepted decisions as a versioned public rule specification without source text or individual record identifiers; mark non-generalizable cases unknown.
Run one fixed diagnostic after the rule version is frozen. Do not use diagnostic records for repeated rule tuning.
Batch only fields accepted by the fixed diagnostic; preserve unknown, processing failure and field-level nonacceptance separately.

current_development_review.note: The partial review was truncated and cannot be counted as a full-document decision review. No private source identifiers are recorded in this public contract.

resource_accounting.boundary: No API calls does not mean that all computation used zero resources.
